hypothesis: Lowering the initial exact-k4 prefilter minimum total shared hits from 4 to 1, while retaining a fixed 100-candidate cap, may recover useful HMM-supported orthology links without the large candidate-cost increase of cap400. The existing reference-conditioned diagnostic gained 1174 accepted watched links, lost 748, and changed candidates from 2034503 to 2040700. These are sensitivity diagnostics, not precision or full orthology F1 evidence.

arms.control: Reuse independently verified canonical arms from canonical_downstream_r1_v1_20261014; their initial searches used the original unchanged CPU libraries and min_total_hits=4. Require matched inputs, native semantics, scorer/runtime/tool identities and verified control status per dataset. Reusing cached controls is not a fresh matched timing comparison.
arms.shared_hit1: Fresh complete-proteome initial HMM search with min_total_hits=1, followed by unchanged strict profile expansion, default refinement, satellite_v2 candidate expansion and independent species/gene-tree inference and native reconciliation.

implementation: Expose search_min_total_hits as an opt-in production CLI/API/benchmark argument; retain default 4 and default call/worker-tuple shapes. Validate positive int32 values and restrict nondefault production use to fresh built-in high_sensitivity with a fixed positive cap. Forward the nondefault value through the multiprocessing worker to initial search only, and record its actual value in metrics. Do not change profile expansion prefilter settings, scoring, significance formulas, adaptive-cap arithmetic, CPP compile flags, graph/refinement/phylogeny rules or defaults.
libraries: Copy the unchanged original hmm_viterbi.so, kmer_prefilter.so and pair_align.so from the frozen full_search_hillclimb_r1_v3_20261012 source into a new private frozen namespace. Match the libraries used by the canonical control, not the separately compiled boundary-clear trial.
validation: Test default compatibility, CLI/API invalid values/combinations, multiprocessing handoff and recorded parameters, then validate a real small fresh native fixture without treating it as real-data accuracy evidence. For complete datasets require bijective FASTA ownership, checkpoint numeric integrity, full unique gene preservation, native pair/confidence validity, actual HMM/profile activation and fresh phylogeny without checkpoint reuse. Read back scores with existing independent helpers.
selection: Report all endpoint deltas, precision/recall, coverage, native pairs/groups, failures and Pareto tradeoffs relative to canonical min4 controls and retained OrthoFinder 3.1.5 full/sequence-only and other-tool comparisons. Any primary improvement with all endpoint declines no worse than 0.005 is only a development screen. FAS remains unseeded; functional similarity is not orthology truth. No default promotion or universal superiority claim from a single exposed round.
execution: Prepare tested frozen implementation now; execute the single sequential dataset task only after job 24240 is terminal. Revalidate each canonical control independently; skip and preserve any failed/unavailable control rather than duplicate it or silently switch baselines. Existing primary, canonical and kernel jobs and unrelated workloads are untouched.
timing_scope: Variant is fresh full-pipeline inference on a shared host; controls are accepted-hit/native-cache replays. Retain per-stage and whole-run wall/CPU/RSS descriptively and disclose competing workloads. Do not infer isolated speed advantage from these unmatched timing scopes.
validity: Development-exposed data only; QfO's 78 species activates broad-panel refinement. Reference labels are never inference inputs. Three Kingdoms and TreeFam remain supplementary/supporting. Keep missing historical archives and timing confounding nonblocking.
git: Commit and push this prespecification before implementation/evaluation, then tested code, frozen execution/launch evidence and validated per-metric results or explicit failures at milestones.
